technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI, MACD, Hull) show bullish structure with exceptional volume spike, but price remains below 200-day MA with weak money flow and overbought oscillators, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: SLV shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; insufficient data for directional bias.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (5+ years old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (290.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong USD pressures commodity valuations, and imminent CPI event adds binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Exceptional 15x volume spike combined with Hull flip and MACD crossover in extreme fear environment (22/100) creates classic contrarian reversal setup with defined support at 17.1567.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below 200-day MA with weak money flow (negative CMF), overbought oscillators signaling pullback risk, inverted yield curve + VIX crisis (290.4) + strong USD headwinds create severe macro headwinds that overwhelm short-term momentum.
